metadata.title: Products
metadata.description: Every product of the Polar organisation, with its prices, its licence key, its sales and what buyers paid for it.

title: Products
description: Every product of the Polar organisation, read from Polar. Sales count paid orders, refunded ones included; amounts are what buyers paid after refunds, in each order's currency.
